insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Qiyana? They go Jarvan IV
insights.text: Qiyana is a G1 favorite (2/2 G1s, played by Grell). In the 4 later games where it was burned or banned, Grell went to Jarvan IV (2/4) and Pantheon (1/4).
